justification: Image A depicts a carved three-dimensional human head with facial features (eyes, nose, mouth with teeth) and a layered headdress, while Image B depicts a flat engraved plaque with abstract geometric and linear motifs (zigzag borders, rectangular frames, small paired curved marks) and no figural or facial imagery. There is no correspondence in subject matter, form, or arrangement between the two; the only faint similarity is a generally schematic, incised/carved treatment of stone-like material, which is too generic to count as shared iconography.
